description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kivuleyaya, Siyambalanduwa, D/S/Division, Monaragala District - Cad. Map No.72007 (24/0055)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels in Kivuleyaya village. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and title classifications, making it primarily focused on land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
